I've answered Ilse in her DM: she should keep Tuesday 10 November at 12:45 free for the Tamsin Cold Chain / Lantern rollout call.

That time comes from my saved note of what she told me in this DM on 14 October: the Lantern call is every Tuesday at 12:45. Two things I couldn't confirm:

- The DM history I can read now only shows today's message, so I can't see her original message from 14 October.
- Her calendar has nothing booked for 9–13 November. I told her the call isn't on there and suggested she add it.
